punchline: At fifty-one, John still described himself in the words of his school reports and his father.
thirty_sec: In Scattered Minds Gabor Maté quotes a letter from John, fifty-one and unemployed, exactly as written. School reports said he did not pay attention or sit still. His father called him a lazy bum. Maté says the shame this leaves weighs more than the attention problem, and that calling someone lazy explains nothing.
